summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 24, 2026 news release reporting assay results from four diamond drill holes at its Guayabales Project in Caldas, Colombia. Hole APC150-D4 returned 8.15 meters grading 14.82 g/t AuEq (0.40% WO3, 8.47 g/t Au, 4 g/t Ag) about 927 meters below surface, the first high-grade tungsten intersection in schist outside the southern Apollo breccia margin, roughly 680 meters below the modeled shallow tungsten zone. Thirteen new veins were reported, seven outside the block model; seventeen holes' assays are pending. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated.
